goal: Generate a main image depicting an athlete jogging in the morning while wearing a smartwatch, with realistic lighting and recognizable products, for use on a website or social media campaigns.

subject.visual_description: Titanium metal case, orange active strap, Always-On screen displaying running performance interface and heart rate
subject.position: In the lower right, occupying the foreground, slightly enlarged dial.

scene.location: Plastic track by the beach in Los Angeles, with palm shadows on one side and low railings, distant sea fog.
extra_props: Dark gray kettle parked in the blurred background

lighting.direction: Low-angle side lighting, emphasizing the muscle lines of the arms and the brushed surface of the case
lighting.color_temp: Slightly warm, suitable for a morning run in Southern California.

human_presence.form: A fictional tall male athlete's back view and mid-shot volume, no frontal face; lifting the left wrist to check the watch, head slightly down, distinguishable short dark curly hair and sleeveless training vest
human_presence.rule: Character should not overshadow wrist products; recognizable as a high-level athlete's silhouette but does not require a portrait-quality frontal view.

style.rendering: 35mm documentary photography style + light grain, non-studio
style.depth: Shallow depth of field emphasizes the dial.
style.consistency: Sea fog gray blue + strap orange as the only accent color

must_keep: watch strap and interface information are clear and readable
The direction of light is consistent with the direction of shadows
Scene as Real Outdoor Running Track Rather Than Studio
avoid: Deliberately close to the portrait details of any specific real public figure
watch dial UI text is blurry
